title: Hybrid resolver: prefer curated answer, fall back to retrieval, return provenance
priority_note: The core of #305/#306: one resolution path that prefers curated, falls back to RAG, and tells the caller which answered. Depends on the curated-source rule (31.1).

background.reference: GitHub issues #305/#306; hub 820602df (the refund-policy hallucination failure mode). Reuses Loopctl.Knowledge.knowledge_search (semantic + keyword_only fallback + meta).
background.includes: US-31.1 defines curated sources. This story adds Loopctl.Knowledge.hybrid_search/2 (or extends knowledge_search) that first tries a curated answer and only falls back to semantic retrieval for the long tail, returning provenance (curated|retrieved) + confidence so callers trust curated and treat retrieved as fuzzy.

story.as_a: an agent querying the knowledge layer
story.i_want_to: call one hybrid retrieval function that returns a curated answer when one exists (flagged curated) and retrieval results otherwise (flagged retrieved), with confidence
story.so_that: I never get a confidently-wrong fuzzy chunk when a canonical answer exists, and I don't have to choose 'RAG or curated' myself

rationale: The harvested failure mode is a hallucinated refund policy from an unrelated chunk — exactly what happens when RAG answers a query that had a canonical answer. Preferring curated when a high-confidence curated match exists, and labeling every answer's provenance, directly prevents that failure while preserving retrieval for the long tail.

acceptance_criteria.description: Loopctl.Knowledge.hybrid_search/2 (tenant-scoped) first attempts a curated match: a high-confidence semantic/keyword match to a curated source (US-31.1). If found above a configurable curated-confidence threshold, it returns that with provenance: :curated. Otherwise it falls back to knowledge_search and returns provenance: :retrieved.

The response always carries provenance (:curated | :retrieved), a confidence/score, and the underlying meta (including knowledge_search's fallback/search_mode when the retrieved path ran) — a single shape callers read without branching on which subsystem answered.
Prefer-curated resolution: when BOTH a curated source and fuzzy chunks match, the curated one wins (the default resolution rule); a canonical article outranks a probabilistic chunk match.

Degradation honesty (SOUL rule 7): if embeddings are unavailable, curated matching may use the keyword path and the response reflects the degraded mode in meta — never a silent empty or a false-curated answer.
Tenant isolation: hybrid_search only ever returns the caller tenant's articles (curated or retrieved); a two-tenant test proves no cross-tenant answer.

test_cases.name: curated answer wins over fuzzy chunk
preconditions: a curated reference article answering 'refund policy'
several low-category chunk-like articles loosely matching
expected_results: returns the curated article with provenance: :curated + confidence; NOT a fuzzy chunk

test_cases.name: long-tail query falls back to retrieval, flagged
preconditions: tenant with only non-curated articles matching a niche query
expected_results: returns retrieval results with provenance: :retrieved + meta (search_mode); no curated claim

test_cases.name: degraded embeddings surface in meta, not a false curated answer
preconditions: EmbeddingCircuitBreaker open; a curated article present
expected_results: meta reflects keyword_only/fallback; provenance honest; no silent empty

test_cases.name: hybrid_search is tenant-isolated
steps: hybrid_search as tenant_b for tenant_a's topic

technical_notes: Function: Loopctl.Knowledge.hybrid_search/2 (or an extension of knowledge_search with a mode); reuse the existing knowledge_search semantic+keyword path and its meta contract (fallback/search_mode).
Curated-confidence threshold is config; below it, do not claim curated.
Prefer-curated is the default resolution rule (AC-31.2.3) — encode explicitly.
No embedding/vector re-architecture (out of scope per #305) — this is resolution on top.
Tests use Loopctl.Fixtures.fixture/2 + Mox embedding stub.
